verdict.rationale: First-party docs state the complete API surface is available in the open-source server under GPL-3.0 and can be self-hosted free forever. The public GitHub repo (typesense/typesense) and many 'open source' claims corroborate this, and a community commenter independently reports skimming the C++ source. Missing for 10: an explicit LICENSE-file citation or documentation of how the Cloud-only features relate to the open-source codebase.
